blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The provincial government has allocated P25.7268 million from its Quick Response Fund (QRF) for immediate assistance and response efforts following weather-related damage estimated at over P2 billion across Occidental Mindoro, according to the Philippine Information Agency in Mimaropa. The PIA report, released on Tuesday, said the province was placed under a state of calamity on Sept. 1 after the southwest monsoon triggered widespread flooding that affected all municipalities and damaged homes, agricultural areas, livestock, and infrastructure. Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Officer Mario Mulingbayan said the QRF was prioritized for communities and sectors most affected […]...
